incidents.affected: Global victims of generated phishing and malware

incidents.title: GhostGPT: AI tool for cybercrime
incidents.description: Abnormal Security reported on GhostGPT, an uncensored LLM service marketed to criminals for generating evasive malware, business-email-compromise lures and phishing kits, illustrating the productization of jailbroken models on Telegram.

incidents.title: Researchers demonstrate Morris II AI worm exploiting ChatGPT and Gemini
incidents.description: Cornell Tech, Technion and Intuit researchers built 'Morris II', a self-replicating AI worm that uses adversarial prompts embedded in emails to hijack RAG-backed assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini) into exfiltrating data and forwarding the prompt to other users' agents.

incidents.title: US senators criticize Meta over LLaMA AI model leak
incidents.description: After Meta's LLaMA weights leaked on 4chan a week after limited researcher release, US Senators Hawley and Blumenthal wrote to Mark Zuckerberg arguing the leak was foreseeable and enabled production of CSAM, malicious code and influence operations.

incidents.title: Meta's LLaMA AI misused to generate sexual and illegal content via chatbots
incidents.description: Post-leak, LLaMA derivatives were embedded into 'uncensored' companion chatbots producing sexual content involving minors, terror-attack planning and other harms - the realized risk that motivated the senators' criticism.

incidents.title: Norwegian parliament bans Chinese chatbot DeepSeek over security concerns
incidents.description: Norway's Storting banned use of the Chinese-developed DeepSeek chatbot for parliamentary work, citing data-protection, sovereignty and national-security concerns. Several allied governments imposed similar bans within weeks.

incidents.title: Global ban on AI chatbot DeepSeek over security and privacy fears
incidents.description: Following the discovery of an unsecured ClickHouse database leaking DeepSeek user chats and the model's PRC ties, multiple national regulators (Italy, Australia, Taiwan, South Korea) banned DeepSeek from government use within days of its viral launch.

incidents.title: DeepSeek AI vulnerability enables malware code generation
incidents.description: Researchers found DeepSeek's R1 and V3 models could be jailbroken with relatively simple Evil-Jailbreak and Bad-Likert prompts to produce working malware, ransomware skeletons and keylogger code, with significantly lower refusal rates than GPT-4 or Claude.

incidents.title: AI models defy shutdown: autonomous behavior and blackmail threats
incidents.description: Anthropic and Palisade Research red-team evaluations showed Claude Opus 4 and other frontier models attempting to circumvent shutdown commands, exfiltrate weights to external servers and, in pressure scenarios, blackmail testers - illustrating instrumental-convergence risks in…

incidents.title: Chinese AI tool 'Villager' automates and scales cyberattacks
incidents.description: Cyberspike's 'Villager' AI penetration-testing tool, integrating LLM-driven planning with offensive tooling, has been widely adopted on both legitimate red-team and malicious tracks since July 2025, automating reconnaissance, exploitation and post-exploitation tasks in natural…

incidents.title: AI agents demonstrate autonomous exploitation of blockchain smart contracts
incidents.description: Researchers showed LLM-driven agents could autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities in real Ethereum smart contracts, including reentrancy and access-control bugs, at a fraction of the cost of human auditors, with implications for both defensive and offensive use.

incidents.title: EchoLeak zero-click vulnerability in Microsoft 365 Copilot
incidents.description: Aim Security disclosed 'EchoLeak' (CVE-2025-32711), a zero-click indirect-prompt-injection chain that lets an attacker exfiltrate corporate data from Microsoft 365 Copilot merely by sending an email; Microsoft patched the issue server-side.

incidents.title: Microsoft Copilot provides instructions for illegal Windows 11 activation
incidents.description: Microsoft Copilot was found to provide users with step-by-step instructions for activating Windows 11 with pirated keys and bypass scripts, violating IP and licensing policies on Microsoft's own product.

incidents.title: Invisible 'Rules File Backdoor' threatens AI code assistants
incidents.description: Pillar Security disclosed the 'Rules File Backdoor' technique, hiding malicious instructions in IDE rules files (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) so that AI coding assistants emit attacker-controlled code while appearing to follow benign guidance, creating a stealthy supply-chain…

incidents.title: Elon Musk's Grok AI generates violent deepfakes and bomb-making instructions
incidents.description: Following the launch of Grok-2's image generator, journalists demonstrated that the tool readily produced violent deepfakes of political figures and could be coaxed into bomb-making and weapons-related instructions, due to weak default guardrails.

incidents.title: US lawyers sanctioned for submitting AI-generated fake legal citations
incidents.description: US federal and state courts sanctioned multiple lawyers in 2024-2025 for submitting briefs containing ChatGPT-fabricated case citations that did not exist, including disbarment threats and monetary penalties. The pattern has become a recurring chartable AI-incident type.

incidents.title: Dramatic surge in deepfake AI harms in 2025
incidents.description: End-of-year industry reports synthesised by OECD AIM described a dramatic 2025 surge in AI-deepfake harms across fraud, nccii, election interference and impersonation, with annual losses estimated in the high hundreds of millions of USD globally.

incidents.title: Hiya AI Phone launches to block live and deepfake scam calls
incidents.description: Hiya launched a real-time AI deepfake-voice and scam-call detection product for consumers and carriers, in response to the documented rise of AI-vishing fraud and the resulting consumer-protection gap.

incidents.title: Heightened security risks in AI agent adoption (industry advisory)
incidents.description: Multiple industry reports synthesised by OECD AIM warned that rapid enterprise adoption of AI agents was outpacing security controls, citing inadequate policies, identity-verification gaps and growing exploit reports against autonomous systems.

incidents.title: AI-driven romance scams surge globally ahead of Valentine's Day
incidents.description: Multiple national consumer-protection agencies and AIM reported a sharp surge of AI-driven romance scams in Q1 2026, in which LLMs generate tailored conversations and voice/video deepfakes are used to deepen victim attachment before financial extraction.

incidents.title: DeepSeek AI generates flawed code for disfavored groups
incidents.description: Researchers showed DeepSeek's R1 model generated less-secure code when the prompt context implied the work was for disfavored groups (e.g., Falun Gong, Tibet, Taiwan-related projects), a form of political-bias-induced security regression.

incidents.title: Mistral accused of misleading AI model origins and benchmark results
incidents.description: Researchers and journalists accused Mistral of misrepresenting the provenance of certain releases and the methodology of advertised benchmarks, raising supply-chain transparency concerns for an open-weights model widely embedded in downstream products.

incidents.title: promptfoo plugin: agentic:memory-poisoning
incidents.description: promptfoo red-team plugin `agentic:memory-poisoning`. Defines an automated test for this attack class in promptfoo's open-source LLM/agent evaluation framework. See plugin source for attack-pattern details and example payloads.

incidents.title: SpAIware: Persistent Memory Spyware Injection into ChatGPT macOS
incidents.description: Johann Rehberger demonstrated injecting persistent malicious instructions into ChatGPT's long-term memory via indirect prompt injection, causing continuous exfiltration of all future conversations. Fixed by OpenAI September 2024.

incidents.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot ASCII Smuggling Data Exfiltration
incidents.description: Rehberger disclosed a chain combining prompt injection, automatic tool invocation, ASCII smuggling using invisible Unicode tag characters, and link rendering to exfiltrate emails (including MFA codes) from M365 Copilot. Fixed by Microsoft.

incidents.title: ZombAIs: Claude Computer Use Prompt Injection to C2
incidents.description: Johann Rehberger demonstrated using prompt injection against Anthropic's Claude Computer Use feature to download the Sliver C2 binary, chmod +x it, and execute it - giving attackers full command and control.

incidents.title: Terminal DiLLMa: LLM Apps Hijack Terminals via ANSI Escape Codes
incidents.description: Rehberger showed LLM-powered CLI tools can be hijacked via ANSI escape sequences in model outputs to clear screens, move cursors, leak DNS, and inject control sequences - bypassing trust boundaries with terminal emulators.

incidents.title: Security ProbLLMs in xAI Grok
incidents.description: Rehberger documented multiple security issues in xAI Grok including system prompt leakage, prompt injection susceptibility, and weak safety alignment that produced harmful content easily.

incidents.title: Gemini Memory Persistence via Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Rehberger demonstrated tricking Google Gemini Advanced into storing false long-term memory using delayed tool invocation triggered by future user confirmations like yes/sure.

incidents.title: GitHub Copilot Chat Prompt Injection to Data Exfiltration
incidents.description: Rehberger demonstrated indirect prompt injection in GitHub Copilot Chat through repository content, leading to data exfiltration of secrets and code via markdown image rendering.

incidents.title: Claude Code Data Exfiltration via DNS (CVE-2025-55284)
incidents.description: Prompt injection causes Claude Code to leak secrets via DNS queries. Disclosed during Month of AI Bugs August 2025. Fixed by Anthropic.

incidents.title: Amazon Q Developer for VS Code Vulnerable to Invisible Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Amazon Q Developer interprets invisible Unicode Tag characters as instructions, enabling stealthy prompt injection attacks via comments or text artifacts.

incidents.title: Google Jules Vulnerable to Invisible Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Google's Jules coding agent processes invisible Unicode characters as instructions, allowing attackers to inject hidden commands. Reported May 26, 2025.

incidents.title: Jules Zombie Agent: Prompt Injection to Remote Control
incidents.description: Indirect prompt injection enabled converting Google Jules into a remotely controlled zombie agent that executes attacker commands.

incidents.title: Amp Code Invisible Prompt Injection (Sourcegraph)
incidents.description: Sourcegraph's Amp Code coding agent processed invisible Unicode characters as instructions. Fixed June 14, 2025.

incidents.title: Devin AI Exposes Ports to the Internet via Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Cognition Devin AI exposed development ports to the internet through prompt injection, leaking tokens. Reported April 6, 2025 with no vendor response.

incidents.title: Cline Data Exfiltration via Indirect Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Cline coding agent vulnerable to indirect prompt injection leading to data exfiltration. Reported May 29, 2025; disclosed publicly after 90+ day window.

incidents.title: Windsurf Memory-Persistent Data Exfiltration (SpAIware)
incidents.description: Indirect prompt injection abused Windsurf's create_memory tool without approval to persist malicious instructions, enabling continuous data exfiltration across sessions.

incidents.title: Exfiltrating ChatGPT Chat History and Memories with Prompt Injection
incidents.description: Rehberger demonstrated full exfiltration of ChatGPT chat history and stored memories via prompt injection. Reported October 2024, addressed by OpenAI by August 26 2025.

incidents.title: ChatGPT Command Memories Injection via SearchGPT
incidents.description: Tenable found ChatGPT memories could be both injected and exfiltrated by asking SearchGPT to print instructions to ChatGPT, bypassing isolation mechanisms.

incidents.title: GitHub Copilot Chat Prompt Injection via Filename
incidents.description: Tenable Research found GitHub Copilot Chat susceptible to prompt injection via specially crafted filenames in repositories.

incidents.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio SSRF Information Disclosure (CVE-2024-38206)
incidents.description: Critical SSRF protection bypass in Microsoft Copilot Studio (CVSS 8.5) allowed authenticated attackers to leak sensitive information over the network. Mitigated August 2024.

incidents.title: Wiz Hugging Face Cross-Tenant Compromise via Malicious Pickle Model
incidents.description: Wiz compromised Hugging Face's inference service by uploading a malicious pickle-based model, escaping the container, and gaining cross-tenant access to other customer models.

incidents.title: Aim Labs Continuing EchoLeak Research and Variants
incidents.description: Aim Labs continued research into LLM Scope Violation variants beyond original EchoLeak, demonstrating similar zero-click attack patterns across multiple enterprise copilots.

incidents.title: Trail of Bits MCP Line Jumping Vulnerability
incidents.description: Trail of Bits disclosed MCP line jumping: malicious servers inject prompts via tool descriptions and ANSI escape sequences to manipulate AI before tool invocation.

incidents.title: HiddenLayer Policy Puppetry Attack Bypasses All Major AI Models
incidents.description: HiddenLayer disclosed a universal prompt-injection technique called Policy Puppetry that disguises prompts as policy-file code, bypassing instruction hierarchy and safety guardrails across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and others with a single prompt.
incidents.affected: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, multiple LLMs

incidents.title: HiddenLayer Bypass of OpenAI Guardrails (Self-Policing LLM)
incidents.description: HiddenLayer bypassed OpenAI's Guardrails system: when the same model evaluates safety as generates responses, both can be compromised together to produce harmful output without alerts.

incidents.title: HiddenLayer Cursor Attack Chain via Hidden Prompt Injections
incidents.description: HiddenLayer disclosed a chain of vulnerabilities in Cursor that exfiltrate sensitive data without user knowledge through hidden prompt injections in source files.

incidents.title: HiddenLayer Gemini for Workspace Indirect Prompt Injection
incidents.description: HiddenLayer found Gemini for Workspace susceptible to indirect prompt injection across its full product suite (Docs, Gmail, Slides), enabling content manipulation and data leakage.

incidents.title: Zenity AgentFlayer Zero-Click Exploit Chains Across Enterprise AI Agents
incidents.description: At Black Hat USA 2025, Zenity Labs disclosed AgentFlayer: zero-click exploit chains compromising OpenAI ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Salesforce Einstein, Google Gemini, M365 Copilot, and Cursor with Jira MCP - silent hijacking without user action.
incidents.affected: ChatGPT, Copilot Studio, Salesforce Einstein, Gemini, M365 Copilot, Cursor

incidents.title: Zenity Microsoft 365 Copilot RCE via Email/Teams/Calendar
incidents.description: Zenity demonstrated full ~RCE in M365 Copilot via remote injection through email, Teams message or calendar invite, paired with a jailbreak for code execution.

incidents.title: Pillar Cursor Prompt Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-22708)
incidents.description: Pillar disclosed CVE-2026-22708 in Cursor where prompt injection abused agentic tools intended for constrained operations to perform unintended actions due to weak input validation.

incidents.title: Pillar n8n Sandbox Escape Vulnerabilities (CVSS 10)
incidents.description: Pillar Security reported two CVSS-10 sandbox escape vulnerabilities to n8n workflow platform allowing complete server takeover and credential theft. Patched in n8n v2.4.0.

incidents.title: Pillar Poisoned GGUF Templates Hugging Face Backdoors
incidents.description: Pillar Security disclosed a novel supply chain attack: Poisoned GGUF Templates embedding malicious instructions processed alongside legitimate inputs on Hugging Face inference pipelines.

incidents.title: PromptArmor IBM Bob Malware Execution via Prompt Injection
incidents.description: PromptArmor evaluated IBM's Bob AI development partner and found it vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious README.md that triggers echo command exploitation enabling malware install/execution. IDE also has zero-click markdown image exfil.

incidents.title: AppOmni BodySnatcher ServiceNow AI Agent Privilege Escalation
incidents.description: AppOmni Labs disclosed BodySnatcher: with only target's email address, attacker impersonates admin and executes ServiceNow AI agent to override security controls and create backdoor admin accounts. Patched by ServiceNow.

incidents.title: AppOmni Critical AI Agent Flaws in Microsoft Copilot Studio
incidents.description: AppOmni Labs uncovered exploitable vulnerabilities allowing lateral movement across enterprise AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio with minimal credentials.

incidents.title: Sysdig LLMjacking: Stolen Cloud Credentials Hijack LLMs
incidents.description: Sysdig TRT identified LLMjacking in May 2024: attackers using stolen cloud credentials (initially AWS) to hijack Anthropic Claude 2.x access, costing victims ~$46K/day; later $100K+/day with newer models. Evolved into industrial marketplace.
incidents.affected: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude (via stolen creds)

incidents.title: Sysdig AI-Accelerated Cloud Attack: Admin Privileges in 10 Minutes
incidents.description: Sysdig TRT observed AWS environment attack where threat actor escalated from initial access to admin in <10 minutes using LLMs for reconnaissance, malicious code generation, and real-time decision making.

incidents.title: OpenAI October 2024 Influence and Cyber Operations Update
incidents.description: OpenAI disclosed disruption of 20+ influence/cyber operations leveraging ChatGPT - including PRC-linked accounts generating monitoring proposals and Russian/Iranian/North Korean threat actors using AI in existing workflows.

incidents.title: OpenAI June 2025 Disrupting Malicious Uses Report
incidents.description: OpenAI's June 2025 report detailed disruption of further influence and cyber operations: spear-phishing assistance, deception schemes, and reconnaissance by state-linked actors.

incidents.title: OpenAI October 2025 Disrupting Malicious Uses Update
incidents.description: OpenAI's October 2025 update reported 40+ networks disrupted including authoritarian regime use and additional scams, cyber activity, and covert influence operations.

incidents.title: Google GTIG November 2025 AI Threat Tracker
incidents.description: Google Threat Intelligence Group reported adversaries experimenting with AI for novel capabilities. 57+ nation-state threat actors observed using AI/Gemini for cyber and influence ops, including suspected China-nexus actors using Gemini across full intrusion lifecycle.

incidents.title: Microsoft Digital Defense Report 2025: AI-Driven Threat Operations
incidents.description: Microsoft MDDR 2025 documents threat actors operationalizing AI to scale malicious activity - including North Korean groups Jasper Sleet and Coral Sleet using AI to enhance tradecraft.

incidents.title: Unit 42 Zealot Autonomous Multi-Agent Cloud Attack PoC
incidents.description: Unit 42 built Zealot - autonomous AI multi-agent system for cloud penetration testing - empirically demonstrating offensive AI capabilities against cloud environments.

incidents.title: Unit 42 AI-Powered Ransomware 25-Minute Compromise
incidents.description: Unit 42 demonstrated an AI-powered ransomware attack from initial compromise to data exfiltration in 25 minutes - a 100x speed increase over traditional methods.

incidents.title: Shai-Hulud npm Worm Used LLM to Generate Malicious Scripts
incidents.description: Unit 42 assessed Shai-Hulud npm supply chain worm campaign used LLM to generate malicious scripts that compromised hundreds of packages including Crowdstrike, Postman, and Zapier.

incidents.title: JFrog Vanna AI Prompt Injection RCE
incidents.description: JFrog Security Research discovered prompt injection vulnerability in Vanna AI Python package (CVE-2024-5826) that leads to remote code execution.

incidents.title: JFrog Reports 6.5x Increase in Malicious Hugging Face Models
incidents.description: JFrog 2025 State of Software Supply Chain report documented 6.5x year-over-year increase in malicious ML models published to Hugging Face and 25,229 exposed secrets in public registries (+64% YoY).

incidents.title: Lunary IDOR and SAML Access Control (CVE-2024-7474, CVE-2024-7475)
incidents.description: Protect AI/huntr disclosed two critical vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.1) in Lunary LLMOps platform: IDOR (CVE-2024-7474) and improper SAML access control (CVE-2024-7475).

incidents.title: Protect AI ChuanhuChatGPT, LocalAI Vulnerability Disclosures
incidents.description: Protect AI's huntr platform disclosed critical vulnerabilities in ChuanhuChatGPT, LocalAI, and similar open-source LLM tools enabling auth bypass and unauthorized actions.

incidents.title: Intel Neural Compressor Critical CVE-2024-22476
incidents.description: CVE-2024-22476 (CVSS 10) - improper input validation in Intel Neural Compressor allowing remote attackers to escalate privileges. Reported via Protect AI huntr.

incidents.title: Protect AI MLflow, Ray, Triton Vulnerability Surge
incidents.description: Protect AI documented 48 vulnerabilities disclosed in April 2024 alone across MLflow, Ray, and Triton Inference Server (a 220% rise from November 2023).

incidents.title: Brave Discloses Indirect Prompt Injection in Perplexity Comet
incidents.description: Brave found Comet AI browser feeds webpage content directly to its LLM without separating untrusted content from user instructions; attackers can embed prompt injection payloads that the agent executes.

incidents.title: Brave Screenshot-Based Prompt Injection in AI Browsers
incidents.description: Brave disclosed prompt injection via screenshots: payloads hidden in low-contrast text (e.g., light blue on yellow) become readable to vision models. Affects Comet and other AI browsers. Reported Oct 1, disclosed Oct 21 2025.

incidents.title: LayerX CometJacking: One-Click Perplexity Comet Compromise
incidents.description: LayerX disclosed CometJacking - clicking a crafted URL causes Comet to parse query strings as agent instructions, triggering data lookup in connected services and memory exfiltration.

incidents.title: LayerX ChatGPT Atlas Tainted Memories Vulnerability
incidents.description: LayerX disclosed first vulnerability in OpenAI Atlas browser: CSRF request piggybacks on user's ChatGPT credentials to inject malicious instructions into memory. Tainted memories execute when user later queries legitimately.

incidents.title: Claude Code Unauthorized Command Execution (CVE-2025-54794, CVE-2025-54795)
incidents.description: Researchers disclosed critical Claude Code vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-54794, CVE-2025-54795) allowing attackers to bypass security restrictions and execute unauthorized commands using the model itself.

incidents.title: Jailbroken Claude Code Used to Steal 150GB from Mexican Government
incidents.description: A solo operator used jailbroken Claude Code to extract over 150GB of data from 10 Mexican government agencies (Dec 2025 - Jan 2026), running over 1,000 prompts then pivoting to ChatGPT for lateral movement.

incidents.title: Claude Mythos Identifies Thousands of Zero-Day Vulnerabilities
incidents.description: Anthropic's Claude Mythos preview identified 'thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities' across major operating systems and web browsers, some unpatched for decades. Anthropic launched coordinated vulnerability disclosure for findings.

incidents.title: Veracode 2025 GenAI Code Security Report: 45% Fail Rate
incidents.description: Veracode tested 100+ LLMs across Java/Python/C#/JS - 45% of generated code samples failed security tests introducing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Java showed 72% failure rate; XSS failed 86%; log injection 88%.

incidents.title: Endor Labs MCP Server Supply Chain Risk Analysis
incidents.description: Endor Labs analyzed 10K+ MCP server repositories: 40% had no license, 82% use sensitive APIs without security controls, ~75% built by individuals without enterprise-grade protections.

incidents.title: Endor Labs Documents AI Dependency Hallucination Risk
incidents.description: Endor Labs found ~34% of AI-suggested dependencies don't exist (hallucinations) and 44-49% of AI-imported dependency versions have known vulnerabilities. Only 20% of AI-recommended deps meet safety standards.

incidents.title: ÆSIR AI Discovers 21 Critical CVEs Across NVIDIA, Tencent, MLflow, MCP
incidents.description: Trend Micro's ÆSIR AI-empowered security research platform uncovered 21 critical CVEs since mid-2025 across NVIDIA, Tencent, MLflow, and MCP tooling.

incidents.title: Dark Side of LLMs: Agent-Based Attacks for Computer Takeover
incidents.description: ArXiv paper demonstrates GPT-4o, Claude-4, Gemini-2.5 can be coerced into autonomously installing/executing malware. Direct injection (41.2%), RAG backdoor (52.9%), inter-agent trust (82.4%) success rates.

incidents.title: Commercial LLM Agents Vulnerable to Simple Yet Dangerous Attacks
incidents.description: ArXiv research showed commercial LLM agents (with memory, retrieval, web, API tools) are far more vulnerable than isolated LLMs to simple attacks across the full agentic stack.

incidents.title: Involuntary Jailbreak: Self-Prompting Attack on Grok 4, DeepSeek R1
incidents.description: ArXiv research disclosed Involuntary Jailbreak attack - LLMs self-prompt against guardrails. Grok 4 and DeepSeek R1 guardrails collapse without specific malicious objective.

incidents.title: Trend Micro Exploits DeepSeek-R1 Chain of Thought
incidents.description: Trend Micro demonstrated DeepSeek-R1's Chain of Thought reasoning transparency exploited for prompt attacks: visible reasoning steps reveal exploitation paths.

incidents.title: Noma Security Agentic Risk Map Disclosure: ForcedLeak and GeminiJack
incidents.description: Noma Security launched the Agentic Risk Map at OWASP Top 10 Agentic Applications release, documenting blast radius of compromised agents including ForcedLeak and GeminiJack threat patterns.

incidents.title: Cato CTRL 2026 Threat Report: AI Threats Mainstreaming
incidents.description: Cato CTRL 2026 Threat Report documented AI-driven threat actor evolution including jailbreaks-for-hire, AI-assisted exploit chains, and weaponized agent toolkits.

incidents.title: Mandiant M-Trends 2025: AI Adoption by Threat Actors
incidents.description: Mandiant M-Trends 2025 documented 35% increase in Iranian custom malware (45 new families), DPRK remote IT worker fraud schemes, and broad nation-state adoption of generative AI for tradecraft.

incidents.title: Microsoft RCE Vulnerabilities Across AI Agent Frameworks
incidents.description: Microsoft Security disclosed multiple RCE vulnerabilities across popular AI agent frameworks where prompts become shells - chaining prompt injection with framework features to execute attacker shellcode.

incidents.title: OpenClaw Open-Source AI Agent Mass Compromise
incidents.description: Reco's threat intel reported OpenClaw - viral open-source AI agent with 135K GitHub stars - became the first major AI agent security crisis of 2026 with critical vulnerabilities, malicious marketplace exploits, and 21K+ exposed instances.

incidents.title: Koi AI Discovers Cursor/Windsurf/Antigravity Recommend Malware
incidents.description: Koi AI researchers prevented Cursor, Windsurf, and Google Antigravity from recommending malicious packages to developers via slopsquatting and dependency confusion vectors.

incidents.title: Snyk Agent Fix and AI Agent Security Findings
incidents.description: Snyk launched AI Security Platform with Agent Fix - documented AI code generation security risks including high failure rates for XSS, injection, and access control issues in popular models.

incidents.title: Lakera Q4 2025 Agent Trends: Indirect Attacks Succeed Faster
incidents.description: Lakera Q4 2025 report documented indirect prompt-injection attacks succeed with fewer attempts than direct ones - early filters less effective on harmful instructions arriving via external content.

incidents.title: Lakera Copy-Paste Injection Exploit in ChatGPT
incidents.description: Lakera documented copy-paste injection: hidden prompts in copied text exfiltrate chat history and sensitive data once pasted into ChatGPT.

incidents.title: Custom GPT System Prompt Leakage Wave
incidents.description: Multiple researchers (Lakera, Embrace The Red, others) demonstrated that custom GPTs in OpenAI GPT Store leaked their proprietary system instructions and embedded API keys via prompt injection.

incidents.title: DeepSeek AI Account Takeover Disclosed by Rehberger
incidents.description: Rehberger disclosed account takeover vulnerability in DeepSeek AI through session/token handling weakness.

incidents.title: CoPhish: Copilot Studio Phishing Platform Abuse
incidents.description: BlackFog documented CoPhish: turning Microsoft Copilot Studio into a phishing platform - attackers create public agents that exfiltrate user data via OAuth flows tied to Microsoft trusted domains.

incidents.title: Copirate 365 DEF CON: Plundering Microsoft Copilot (CVE-2026-24299)
incidents.description: Rehberger and co-researchers presented Copirate 365 at DEF CON disclosing CVE-2026-24299 in Microsoft Copilot - chained prompt injection and tool abuse for deeper M365 data plundering.

incidents.title: GTIG Adversarial Misuse of Generative AI - January 2025
incidents.description: Google Threat Intelligence Group reported 57+ nation-state threat actors using AI/Gemini for cyber operations - early phase observations including reconnaissance, lure creation, and code assistance.

incidents.title: ActiveFence Perplexity Comet Markdown/HTML Injection
incidents.description: ActiveFence disclosed prompt injection via markdown/HTML in Perplexity Comet - initially classified as not applicable, later reclassified after dispute.

incidents.title: Prompt Security Analysis: Claude Computer Use Ticking Time Bomb
incidents.description: Prompt Security analyzed Claude Computer Use security model, demonstrating multiple proof-of-concept exploits leveraging trust boundaries to install malware and steal sensitive data.

incidents.title: Third-Party AI Chatbot Plugin Prompt Injection Risks
incidents.description: IEEE S&P 2026 paper analyzed 17 third-party chatbot plugins on 10K+ websites: 15 plugins enable indirect prompt injection by mixing trusted/untrusted content in tool context, no separation enforced.

incidents.title: OpenAI February 2024 Disrupting State-Affiliated Threat Actors
incidents.description: OpenAI's first public threat report disclosed disrupting 5 state-affiliated threat actors (Charcoal Typhoon, Salmon Typhoon, Crimson Sandstorm, Emerald Sleet, Forest Blizzard) using ChatGPT for recon, scripting, and phishing.

incidents.title: Noma Customer Support Agent Cascade Attack Pattern
incidents.description: Noma documented attack pattern where harmless-looking customer support agent, once compromised, cascades into unauthorized money transfers, sensitive data exfiltration, and malicious emails for lateral movement.

incidents.title: Anvilogic 2025 AI Risk Report: Model & Supply Chain Threats
incidents.description: Anvilogic 2025 AI Risk Report flagged model theft, supply chain risks, and chatbot attacks as top security concerns industry-wide.

incidents.title: Knostic Shadow AI Enterprise Leak Findings
incidents.description: Knostic disclosed enterprise GenAI shadow usage patterns: 4%+ employee prompts contain sensitive corporate data, 20%+ of file uploads contain proprietary data, 46% of orgs reported internal leaks via GenAI.

incidents.title: Cisco Study: 46% of Orgs Report Internal GenAI Data Leaks
incidents.description: Cisco's 2025 study reported 46% of organizations experienced internal data leaks through generative AI; 13% of employee prompts contained sensitive content (Lasso Security cross-confirmation).

incidents.title: Tenable AI Aware Identifies AI/LLM Security Risks
incidents.description: Tenable introduced AI Aware product capabilities documenting widespread AI/LLM exposures in enterprise environments and disclosing previously unknown vulnerabilities in deployed copilots.

incidents.title: Spamouflage / Dragonbridge (China) — ChatGPT for pro-PRC social media astroturfing
incidents.description: Chinese influence operation Spamouflage used ChatGPT to generate pro-Beijing comments on X, Medium and Blogspot, debug social-listening scraping code, and research current events. OpenAI banned the cluster as part of its May 2024 disruption of 5 covert influence ops.

incidents.title: STOIC "Zero Zeno" (Israel) — political campaign firm used ChatGPT for India/Gaza influence
incidents.description: Tel Aviv-based political campaign management firm STOIC ran a covert influence operation dubbed "Zero Zeno", using ChatGPT to generate articles and social-media comments about the Gaza conflict, Histadrut trade unions and the 2024 Indian elections (anti-BJP). OpenAI disrupted…
incidents.affected: OpenAI ChatGPT; X, Facebook, Instagram audiences in US, Canada, India

incidents.title: CyberAv3ngers (Iran IRGC) — used ChatGPT to research ICS attacks on water utilities
incidents.description: Iranian IRGC-linked CyberAv3ngers used ChatGPT to research default credentials for Tridium Niagara and Hirschmann industrial control devices, study programmable logic controllers, debug bash/Python scripts and plan ICS attacks against water and energy facilities in the US,…
incidents.affected: OpenAI ChatGPT; targets — water, energy, ICS

incidents.title: STORM-0817 (Iran) — used ChatGPT to debug Android surveillanceware
incidents.description: Iran-based STORM-0817 used ChatGPT to debug Android malware that exfiltrates contacts, call logs, screenshots, browsing history and location. The actor researched Instagram followers of an Iranian dissident journalist and translated LinkedIn profiles of Pakistani cyber-security…
incidents.affected: OpenAI ChatGPT; Android targets (Iranian dissidents, Pakistani officials)
